display_review: Mostly upheld. race_blurb is accurate and neutral on Frank Imhof: it states that he submitted no statement, that the PDC lists his campaign as discontinued and that his name stays on the ballot, which matches frank-imhof.md S1, S2 and S3 (PDC status 'Candidate discontinued campaign', VoteWA active). It does not call him withdrawn, and withdrawn false is correct because he remains an active candidate on the ballot. Imhof's summary and highlights are neutral and sourced; the IMCO highlight is hedged ('a Frank Imhof') as the dossier is. pamphlet-only is honest. Ury's summary and four highlights are supported by S1 and S4. Two problems. First, office_does says the PUD 'builds broadband', but _contest.md only supports that it 'has partnered with the Port of Bellingham and Whatcom County on broadband for underserved areas' [S9]; 'builds' overstates the PUD's role. Second, Ury's evidence_level 'rich' (copied from the dossier frontmatter) is generous: the dossier has his pamphlet statement, the PUD bio, 2024 campaign coverage and one 2026 geothermal item, but no public 2026 campaign website (S9 shows a private page), no endorsements, no PDC reports and no 2026 race coverage. Comparable Whatcom port candidates with campaign sites, questionnaires and 2026 news are rated moderate, so moderate is the honest level here; the dossier frontmatter and scoring file should change together.
